_doc: The game's parts and what each holds: rooms, close-ups, characters, dialogue folders and cutscenes. Read by src/core/chapters.gd, the every-room test, the QA room tour and tools/build/export.sh, which leaves every part without "web": true out of the browser build. `flags`, `memories` and `items` are what a player holds on reaching the part's start, so QA and tests can start mid-game. List rooms as they are built.
